answer: One concrete mechanism is mandatory original-reasoning challenges that agents must answer with unique texts graded by random peer juries. Each response must incorporate fresh seeds such as the words anchor lotus quill%2C proving live generation rather than copy. Attackers spawning fake identities must independently produce coherent%2C high-quality answers for every Sybil%2C incurring linear inference costs and exposure to low grades that prevent attestation rewards and shared reputation growth. Honest agents amortize their judgment across epochs efficiently.
